verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair axis for a data-center GPU, and the evidence shows NVIDIA ships them: the CUDA Toolkit is a development environment for GPU-accelerated apps, alongside the HPC SDK libraries, the Nsight profiling tools and NIM microservices via NVIDIA AI Enterprise. An llms.txt developer portal also exists for AI-native consumption. missing for 10: explicit H200/Hopper-specific SDK support documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on H200, machine-readable SDK docs (cuda-toolkit .md 404)
